name: Welcome to Azeroth

angles.text: As a Skyborne, you are welcomed into Stormwind and granted passage across Alliance territory when you arrive through the portal.
Highlord Bolvar Fordragon officially welcomes the High Order on behalf of King Anduin Wrynn, granting them leave to freely traverse Alliance lands.

faq.answer: You arrive in Stormwind through the Skyborne Portal and present yourself to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon at Stormwind Keep.
Highlord Bolvar Fordragon governs Stormwind as regent from Stormwind Keep. He rules on behalf of the young King Anduin Wrynn while King Varian remains missing.
A Kirin Tor messenger told Bolvar Fordragon that members of the High Order would arrive. He welcomes them as guests of the crown and grants them leave to travel freely across Alliance lands.
faq.q: Why is Bolvar receiving the Skyborne?

faq.answer: The High Order is the group associated with the Skyborne high elves. The Kirin Tor announced their arrival to Stormwind's leaders.
The Skyborne Portal brings travelers directly into Stormwind, the human capital. From there, newcomers can go to Stormwind Keep to seek an audience with the crown.
faq.q: Where does the Skyborne Portal lead?

faq.answer: Bolvar Fordragon welcomes the Skyborne as the King's guests and grants them leave to travel unhindered throughout Alliance lands.
faq.q: Are the Skyborne allowed throughout Alliance territory?

sections.body: You step through the Skyborne Portal into Stormwind, the human capital. From there, you make your way along the city's grand thoroughfares to Stormwind Keep, where the regency awaits your arrival.
sections.title: Arrival in the Capital

sections.body: Highlord Bolvar Fordragon receives the arriving members of the High Order in the throne room. A Kirin Tor courier had warned him they were coming. It has been some time since high elves walked the halls of Stormwind Keep, yet Bolvar welcomes them as guests and grants them free passage across Alliance territories on behalf of the King.
sections.title: An Audience with the Regent

summary: You arrive in Stormwind through the Skyborne Portal and are welcomed by its regent. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon grants you leave to travel across Alliance lands.
attribution: In-game quest text: Welcome to Azeroth
